title: Two wizards in the Commons see each other appear, move, jump, lose a client process and resume
notes: Two clients enter WizardCity/WC_Hub on accounts and wizards of their own. The main wizard enters first and backs
away from the zone's Start, so the companion appears in front of it; the game server shows each to the other.
The companion turns around to face the main wizard, which a right turn held 1.27 s does at the 2.47 rad/s the saved
facings of an earlier run measured, then runs a full circle with W and D held together for 2.5 s, stops and jumps while the main
client is filmed every quarter second, which shows the moves and movement states the main client is sent.
The companion's process is ended without a logout, so the main wizard sees it stand still and receive the
link-dead notice. The companion then reconnects before the 300-second retention expires, resuming with the
same mobile id and without a duplicate.
A client asks for the riders of what another wizard rides with MSG_RIDERSLIST once it sees that wizard; the reply
loads the rider list of a RidableBehavior, which no milestone answers yet, so the request is expected and left unanswered.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
